description: NASHUA, N.H. — Last week, Governor Kelly Ayotte’s announced an across-the-aisle outreach effort with the re-launch of its Democrats for Kelly coalition. Five prominent New Hampshire Democrats will serve as Co-Chairs and will support the campaign’s efforts to reach across the aisle and emphasize Governor Ayotte’s record of bipartisan leadership on housing, public safety, childcare, and other issues […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kelly for New Hampshire, Inc
title: Ayotte Campaign Launches Democrats for Kelly Outreach with New Co-Chairs - Kelly Ayotte for Governor
